title: Hamilton College (Hamilton)
summary: Hamilton College (Hamilton) is a university in Clinton. This entry compiles College Scorecard figures and related sources; UniRepository is not affiliated with Hamilton.

sections.heading: What Hamilton is known for
paragraphs: Hamilton College is a private nonprofit institution known for its selective admissions and commitment to undergraduate education. With an enrollment of approximately 2,030 students, Hamilton offers a focused academic environment. The college maintains a competitive admission rate of about 13.62%, reflecting its selective nature. While Hamilton does not have programs in health or business fields, it is recognized for providing a broad liberal arts education. The college's private nonprofit status underscores its dedication to academic excellence and student development.

sections.heading: How to read Hamilton tuition
paragraphs: Hamilton College (Hamilton) charges a tuition fee of $68,960 for both in-state and out-of-state students, reflecting a uniform tuition policy regardless of residency. This comprehensive figure provides a clearer understanding of the overall financial commitment required to attend Hamilton.
